reasons: The redline reaches the playbook's preferred position: it adds Licensee Data ownership, assignment of paid-for customization deliverables (expressly tying back to Article VII(b)), a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded Licensor IP, and an express no-joint-ownership sentence.

The edit is additive and minimal: Licensor's ownership of the Licensed Technology and its notice/protection covenants are left intact, consistent with the guidance that Vendor keeping its platform is acceptable, and the 'Notwithstanding the foregoing' lead-in resolves the conflict with the broad DERIVATIVE WORK definition.
No assignment of Customer IP or data to Licensor remains, and no joint ownership is created, so the walk-away triggers are cleared; deterministic checks are consistent with this.
The comment accurately describes what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and appropriately flags the licence-back fallback without lecturing; tone and prefix conform.
